explanations.columnLevel: Per-column distribution similarity against the uploaded source data.
explanations.columnPairLevel: Pairwise correlation or association similarity against the uploaded source data.
explanations.diagnosticScore: Share of SDMetrics validity checks passed; 1.0 means all configured checks passed.
explanations.diagnostics: Data validity diagnostics such as boundary and schema checks.
explanations.overallQualityScore: Average of SDMetrics column-shape and column-pair similarity scores; 1.0 is the closest match.

limitations: Statistical similarity does not mean the synthetic data is clinically valid.
Scores are computed only over the columns and transformations used for training.
